source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: [Temple Relics](vsdata:ability/black-templars.chaplain-grimaldus.temple-relics) lets you select this option as your [Command phase](vsdata:core-rule/command-phase) begins if at least one Cenobyte is still in the unit. The unit gets +1 **T**, expiring as your following [Command phase](vsdata:core-rule/command-phase) begins.

activity.condition: one or more Cenobytes in owning unit
activity.duration: until start of own next Command phase
